product.title: Osaka local food and Japanese cuisines cooking experience

description.text: In Osaka, this small-group cooking class meets at a Fukushima Ward studio in Yoshino for hands-on work on okonomiyaki, miso soup, and green tea, then a shared tasting of the cooked dishes. A cooking instructor and guide are listed, with the group capped at eight. The format suits visitors who want a guided kitchen window without booking a street-food crawl. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Osaka, and the itinerary stays on the Osaka cooking studio and shared tasting table that define this class rather than a Kuromon stall walk.

highlights: Shared tasting of the cooked dishes

end.description: Return to your Osaka meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
